title: Lipozero vs EMS Zero vs Liposonix
h1: 5D Lipozero, EMS Zero or Liposonix: which body contouring is right for you?
desc: Compare non-surgical body contouring in Dubai: 5D Lipozero, EMS Zero + RF and Liposonix. What each targets, sessions, downtime and prices.
answer: 5D Lipozero reduces fat and tightens skin with radiofrequency, cavitation and vacuum (from AED 600 + VAT per area). EMS Zero + RF builds muscle and reduces fat together (from AED 2,100 + VAT per area). Liposonix destroys a larger volume of stubborn fat in one session using focused ultrasound. The right one depends on whether your goal is fat, skin or muscle.
body:
## Choose by goal

- Soft, loose tummy or arms: 5D Lipozero
- Toned abs or lifted glutes: EMS Zero + RF
- A stubborn belly or flank bulge: Liposonix
- All three: combine over a plan

## Who these treatments suit

People close to their target weight with specific areas that don't respond to diet and exercise. None of them are weight-loss treatments.

## Results

Fat reduction shows over 4 to 12 weeks. Muscle changes from EMS Zero appear after the course and improve for a few weeks.
faq: Can I combine EMS Zero and Lipozero?
Yes, they work on different layers and pair well.
Liposonix for a larger bulge in one session; Lipozero for fat plus skin tightening.
Yes, with a stable weight and activity.
